supplied_by: Auditor (Team 9), for the Procurement Legislation thresholds the Contract Procedure Rules refer to (clause 1.4, App B footnote ***) but do not state
applies_to: Spend window May-July 2026 (Over500_2026_P02-P04) and contracts awarded on or after 1 January 2026
authority_type: sub-central government authority (a local authority is neither a central government authority nor a utility)
vat_basis: The Act's thresholds include VAT (Procurement Act 2023, s.123; threshold guidance para 1: 'estimated value (including VAT)'). The Contract Procedure Rules and the spend data's Net amount are exclusive of VAT, so apply_thresholds.py converts each figure to its VAT-exclusive equivalent at the standard rate below.
vat_rate_note: Standard UK VAT rate. Care and education placements (light touch services) are often exempt from VAT, so for them the VAT-inclusive figure may be the closer comparison; the light-touch tier is reported with both figures.

sources.title: The Procurement Act 2023 (Threshold Amounts) (Amendment) Regulations 2025 (amending Schedule 1 to the Procurement Act 2023)

not_supplied.STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_RELEVANT: Not a separate figure: it means whichever of the three thresholds fits each contract's type. The spend data has no reliable contract-type field, so tests citing it stay skipped and are listed under 'skipped' with this reason.
